visual_action: A young boy, Jeremiah, asks Vice President Kamala Harris a question during a TV interview on a talk show set. Harris, wearing a purple suit, answers him while seated on a couch. The camera cuts between Harris speaking, the boy listening, and the show's host, Jennifer Hudson, reacting. At the end, Harris and Jeremiah hug.

on_screen_text.text: Vice President Harris’ message to young people 💙
what advice do you have to the kids
that want to grow up and be president
you are going to work very hard.
And when you do the work
and all the other things come.
Thank you so much for talking to me,

spoken_summary: A young boy named Jeremiah asks Vice President Kamala Harris for her advice to children who aspire to be president or vice president. Harris advises them to "Follow your passion," because working hard at something you enjoy leads to doing it well, and success will follow. Jeremiah then thanks her, and Harris hugs him.
audio_music: The audio consists of dialogue from a TV talk show interview. Sounds of a live studio audience applauding are heard at the beginning and after Harris gives her answer. There is no musical score.
editing_pacing: The editing follows a standard TV talk show format, with cuts between different camera angles showing the person speaking (Jeremiah and Harris) and reaction shots of the other participants (Harris, Jeremiah, and the host). The pacing is conversational.
central_claim: Vice President Kamala Harris encourages young people to follow their passions as the path to success.
intended_effect: To portray Vice President Harris as inspiring, warm, and personable, particularly in her interaction with a child.
